audit_title: King Wen Structural Preservation — 56-File Provenance Audit

findings.evidence: All 68 ledger-listed JSON artifacts are present in the ZIP and their actual SHA-256 values match the ledger. The 69th JSON is the reconciliation ledger itself.
All 56 entries marked pending are present; all 56 actual SHA-256 values match the ledger.
No source PDF files are present in the ZIP. Declared source hashes remain self-reported metadata and cannot be independently recomputed from source bytes.

1505.05770_end_to_end_audit.json records freeze-manifest SHA-256 2c8d99d35ace4f413948ecc6231b68bb001d84aa21a86d9e76cb901d5e89c10a; actual included 1505.05770_blind_renders_freeze_manifest.json SHA-256 is 02d7af7a95e8cf930ec543ba64672fb174afd3ea0840df9436742f605dee65db. This is a freeze-artifact dependency mismatch, not proof of PDF contamination.

Independent source-byte verification remains blocked.

Page observations, region assessments, and v3 proposals consistently declare document 2009.00031 and PDF SHA-256 99625022dd1880bc3d46c91d177f30654d1b993cf681bc0b277733ccdfbb4869; page 5 is consistently represented. Independent source-byte verification remains blocked.

Positive-control manifest, v2/v3 hierarchical proposals, structural completeness audit, and three-fidelity evaluation consistently declare PDF SHA-256 916b5f4abe2bb5fdd2093bd1ca6ad8a6268e3f16b3837f51970c5dbb787e677c; principal target is page 4. Internal manifest/proposal/evaluation SHA references resolve to included files.

The frozen registry and source-selection matrix identify 1905.07953, 2102.03334, and 2605.24856; the extension registry separately adds 1406.2661 as PAPER_04_GAN. These are intended cross-paper references, not contamination by themselves.

per_file_dispositions.Equation / target identity: Equation numbers are structural metadata attachments, not geometric expression contents.; Typeset display equations place equation numbers at the column margin. In ViLT Page 4, the blank whitespace gap between mathematical formula and equation number ranges from 76.3 pt (Eq 1) to 129.3 pt (Eq 6). A single continuous bounding box encompassing both expression and equation number forces up to 129 pt of blank whitespace into the gold target, mathematically capping the maximum achievable IoU of a tight expression detector to between 0.35 and 0.55.; In VILT-001, the feature check 'has_equation_number_1' passed because the string '1' appeared in subscript t_1 T, not because the right-margin equation number '(1)' was part of the proposal body. In VILT-002, no numeral '2' existed in the formula, correctly exposing that '(2)' was not within proposal L4_line_072.; Tightly bounds the mathematical expression tokens excluding right-margin blank whitespace and equation number.; Tightly bounds the equation label/number at the margin.; Spans the full line width including whitespace and equation number (legacy compatibility).; VILT-004; 4; VILT-006; 6; VILT-005; 5; VILT-003; 3; VILT-002; 2; … (+2)
